weapons.why: Sprays a stream of water droplets that pierce enemies.

weapons.name: Diamond Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Strongest gem staff, firing a fast diamond bolt.

weapons.name: Ruby Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Gem staff firing a ruby bolt.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.

weapons.name: Wand of Frosting
weapons.source: Crafted at By Hand
weapons.why: Frost-flavored upgrade of the Wand of Sparking that fires an icy bolt.

weapons.name: Wand of Sparking
weapons.source: Found in surface/underground Chests or sold by the Skeleton Merchant
weapons.why: Fires a short-range spark bolt and is the earliest magic weapon.

weapons.name: Gray Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (pre-Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam that ricochets and varies in size.

weapons.name: Space Gun
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Rapidly fires fast-moving lasers and costs no mana with Meteor armor.

weapons.name: Amethyst Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Lowest-tier gem staff that fires a straight amethyst bolt.

weapons.name: Emerald Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Gem staff firing an emerald bolt.

weapons.name: Sapphire Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Gem staff firing a sapphire bolt.

weapons.name: Topaz Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Gem staff firing a topaz bolt, slightly stronger than the Amethyst Staff.

weapons.name: Vilethorn
weapons.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt Crates
weapons.why: Projects a piercing line of thorns through blocks and enemies.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts, or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.

armor.name: Jungle Armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: +6% magic damage · +12% magic critical strike chance · +80 maximum mana · +16% mana cost reduction · Emits grass particles while moving.

accessories.name: Celestial Cuffs
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Adds mana-on-hit and extra maximum mana to a caster build.
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for mana stars · Restores mana when damaged · Increases maximum mana by 20

accessories.name: Magnet Flower
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Combines the Mana Flower and Celestial Magnet into one slot.
accessories.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Increases pickup range for mana stars

accessories.name: Mana Regeneration Band
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Increases the player's max mana by 20 and the player's passive mana regeneration by 1 MP/s.

accessories.name: Cloud in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Grants a double jump for extra vertical mobility.

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Increases movement speed while running.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table, or found in Shadow Chests and Pots in the Underworld.
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Lesser Mana Potion
buffs.source: Purchased from the Merchant, or found in Wooden and Pearlwood Crates from fishing

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table, or dropped by slimes.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Granted by eating most cooked food.
buffs.why: A minor boost to all stats.

buffs.name: Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted, or found in most Crates
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table, or found in Shadow Chests and Pots in the Underworld.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Arcane Crystal
buffs.source: Made by dropping a Mana Crystal into Shimmer.

items.name: Aglet
items.source: Found in surface Chests, Wooden Crates, and Pearlwood Crates
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 5%.

items.name: Climbing Claws
items.source: Found in surface Chests (including Water Chests), rarely in Wooden and Pearlwood Crates; sold by the Skeleton Merchant
items.why: Lets you cling to block sides and slowly slide down them in midair.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.notes: If acquired early, the Fledgling Wings' vertical mobility is significantly improved with the Frog Leg.

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Any double-jump bottle works here: Cloud in a Bottle (Underground and Cavern Chests), Blizzard in a Bottle (Frozen Chests), Sandstorm in a Bottle (Pyramid Chests), or Tsunami in a Bottle (Ocean Chests).

items.name: Flying Carpet
items.source: Found in Chests inside Pyramids in the Desert
items.why: Enables the player to briefly hover.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Skyware Chests, Sky Crates, and Azure Crates
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.notes: If acquired early, the Fledgling Wings' vertical mobility is significantly improved with the Frog Leg.

items.name: Shiny Red Balloon
items.source: Found in Skyware Chests on Floating Islands
items.why: Increases jump height of the player.

items.name: Anklet of the Wind
items.source: Found in Ivy Chests in Jungle Shrines and at the base of Living Mahogany Trees, or in Jungle and Bramble Crates, in the Underground Jungle
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 10%.

items.name: Panic Necklace
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop and Ecto Mist
items.why: Briefly increases the player's movement speed after they take damage.

items.name: Lucky Horseshoe
items.source: Found in Skyware Chests and Sky Crates
items.why: Negates fall damage.

items.name: Shackle
items.source: Dropped by most Zombies
items.why: Increases the player's defense by 1.

items.name: Band of Regeneration
items.source: Found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern, and in Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle
items.why: Increases the player's passive health regeneration by 1 HP/s (which ignores the effects of the Bleeding debuff).

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.

items.name: Celestial Magnet
items.source: Found in Azure Crates, Sky Crates, and Skyware Chests (Floating Islands)
items.why: Pulls in mana stars from a wider range.
items.effect: Increases pickup range for mana stars

items.name: Nature's Gift
items.source: Found growing on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle
items.why: Reduces mana cost by 6%.

items.name: Mana Flower
items.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Auto-drinks mana potions and cuts mana cost.
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed

items.name: Band of Starpower
items.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt and Defiled Crates
items.why: +20 maximum mana for early casters.

weapons.name: Abigail's Flower
weapons.source: Found growing on grass near a placed Tombstone
weapons.why: Summons Abigail, a single ghost minion that grows stronger with each re-summon.

weapons.name: Finch Staff
weapons.source: Found in Living Wood Chests
weapons.why: Summons a Baby Finch minion and is a common starter summon weapon.

weapons.name: Flinx Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Work Bench
weapons.why: Summons a Flinx minion.

weapons.name: Vampire Frog Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Zombie Merman and Wandering Eye Fish (Blood Moon)
weapons.why: Summons a Vampire Frog minion; obtainable during a Blood Moon.

weapons.name: Cobwhip
weapons.source: Crafted at Loom
weapons.why: Cheapest early whip.

weapons.name: Leather Whip
weapons.source: Purchased from the Zoologist (10 Gold)
weapons.why: Bought from the Zoologist and directs minions onto the struck target.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: A whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.

weapons.name: Cattiva
weapons.source: Found during the day on surface grass, Jungle grass, Snow or Ice (guarded by two Goblin Archers)
weapons.why: Summons a single Cattiva minion that also mines and cuts trees near the player.

weapons.name: Foxparks
weapons.source: Found during the day on surface grass, Jungle grass, Snow or Ice (guarded by two Goblin Archers)
weapons.why: Summons a single Foxparks minion with a held flamethrower attack.

weapons.name: Slime Staff
weapons.source: Rare drop from most slimes, Slimed Zombies, and King Slime
weapons.why: Summons a Baby Slime minion; has one of the lowest drop rates in the game.

weapons.name: Mushroom Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a Mushroom Boi minion.

weapons.name: Soulscourge
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Corruption whip.

weapons.name: Vasculash
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart to the Soulscourge.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle chests or Jungle Crates
accessories.why: Increases melee attack speed and grants autoswing to melee weapons.

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.
accessories.notes: The player should use the Shark Tooth Necklace (or its upgrade) if they are unable to consistently damage the Wall of Flesh's eyes, as its mouth has considerably higher defense.

accessories.name: Cloud in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Grants a double jump for extra vertical mobility.

accessories.name: Shiny Red Balloon
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests on Floating Islands
accessories.why: Increases jump height of the player.

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Increases movement speed while running.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.why: Increases your maximum number of minions by 1.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table, or dropped by slimes.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Granted by eating most cooked food.
buffs.why: A minor boost to all stats.
